cohort: Multigravida women with at least three antenatal checkups at R.G. Kar Medical College and Hospital, Kolkata, West Bengal, India
finding: Short interpregnancy intervals (<2 years) were associated with increased risk of maternal anemia, scar dehiscence, postpartum hemorrhage, low birth weight, preterm birth, and NICU admission.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was assessed as an outcome.
